review_type: Independent read-only source contract review of the hosted speaker-cache preparation correction
decision: No concrete source-level blocker in the frozen correction. This is readiness for the separately authorized hosted preparation and pipeline, not a claim that the new preparation or speaker inference has succeeded.

source_contract_findings.topic: Remote source filename and local cache filename
source_contract_findings.finding: The same SHA-pinned YAML is transferred and retained before any ECAPA checkpoint transfer. PyYAML compose inspects tags/nodes only. Exactly the existing four loadables and their explicit paths must exist, with the exact repository base; source names derive from those paths while local filenames remain <loadable>.ckpt. No remote label filename is guessed.

source_contract_findings.topic: Safe source paths and exact content identity
source_contract_findings.finding: The pinned common.safe_filename permits only one relative ASCII component beginning with a letter/digit and followed by letters/digits/underscore/dot/hyphen. Slash/traversal, URL syntax, query/fragment, backslash, encoded delimiters, whitespace and nested references reject. Duplicate remote names and conflict with hyperparams.yaml reject before checkpoint transfers. All original local expected SHA256 and size caps remain unchanged.

The retained SpeechBrain v1.1.2 Pretrainer.collect_files uses a configured remote filename separately from save_filename=name+.ckpt. The corrected savedir therefore keeps local names, and the HF snapshot hardlinks each verified payload under its actual remote source name. The exact repository and revision are unchanged.

A pending transfer receipt records family, remote/local filename, exact query-free URL and expected digest before each attempt. Verified YAML and the resolved mapping are saved before checkpoint transfer. Early runtime_identity stage is initialized before version queries; original failures are preserved with stage and optional active transfer, and HTTP status is recorded. There is no retry.

Only the two existing preparation functions, extracted prepare_model_files, urllib.error import and default follow-up plan reference change. Nine other helper functions are AST-identical. The workflow differs only in the plan path. Original d62 helper/controls/workflow/plan are copied byte-for-byte; original failure and earlier review remain immutable.

owner_model_free_controls.review_method: Read exact test changes and bound retained successful log; did not rerun the same controls.

meaningful_new_controls: A synthetic declared .txt remote name maps to unchanged .ckpt savedir and actual remote-name HF snapshot.
Verified YAML, resolved map and failed request receipt survive the first synthetic checkpoint HTTP404, with no retry.
Unsafe, external, duplicate, nested and unresolvable paths reject before checkpoint transfer.
A runtime metadata failure preserves its original exception and initial stage.

remaining_observation_limits: Exact pinned ECAPA YAML bytes and its actual remote label filename were unavailable locally; no previously rejected metadata fetch was retried. The actual hosted preparation must supply these observations before inference.
Model payload identities in the first failed artifact are transfer receipts; the downloaded artifact does not contain the weights.
No model/provider/native/tokenizer work, new download, Git mutation, production change, test rerun, new corpus or criterion change was performed by this review.
This setup correction does not establish speaker accuracy, timestamp quality, or resource success for the eventual application run.
